trials.claim: Includes all future Bronze, Silver, Gold plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Bronze (Tier 1), Silver (Tiers 2, 3), Gold (Tier 4, 5) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show standard rights to modify terms or terminate for violations or other reasons; they do not say future Bronze, Silver, or Gold updates will be withheld from deal buyers, and no exhibit confirms the update promise.

exhibits.quote: We may modify these Terms and Conditions at any time at our sole discretion.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can unilaterally change the terms, which undermines a promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your account and access to the Service at our sole discretion, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms and Conditions, is harmful to other users, us, or third parties, or for any other reason.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can terminate access for any reason, which allows it to take back lifetime access.

trials.claim: Monitor rankings, optimize pages and generate GEO-ready content for AI search
trials.claimQuote: Monitor rankings, optimize pages, and generate GEO-ready content for AI search
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes turning opportunities into complete SEO and GEO articles, and a buyer confirms useful recommendations and accurate generated content. Isolated complaints about citation or cannibalization results do not negate that the monitoring, optimization, and generation features exist.

exhibits.quote: Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Meta "cited" us on all 63, mostly at #1.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports inflated identical citation results across engines, undermining ranking monitoring accuracy.

exhibits.quote: The cannibalization detector counts # anchors on the same URL as separate competing pages.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports faulty page analysis logic, undermining the claim to optimize pages correctly.

exhibits.quote: Turn mapped opportunities into briefs and complete SEO + GEO articles with relevant generated visuals.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the platform generates complete SEO and GEO articles from mapped opportunities.

exhibits.quote: The recommendations are genuinely useful, and the content it generates is remarkably accurate and well-reasoned.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool generates useful and accurate content as promised.

trials.claim: Connects to Google Search Console to surface SEO gaps and generate content from one workspace
trials.claimQuote: Nuwtonic connects to Google Search Console to surface SEO gaps, track AI mentions, and generate GEO-ready content from one workspace.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states it uses Google Search Console data to surface gaps and produce fixes, and a buyer confirms connecting Search Console took only a few minutes. Limits on multiple properties or bulk work do not contradict the claimed single-workspace connection.

exhibits.quote: Limited to one search console. Lots of good reviews. But if working with more then one GSC.... Fails.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the GSC connection fails for multiple properties, limiting the claimed workspace.

exhibits.quote: you do have to plan credits across projects so you don't burn them on low-value generations, audits and prompt tracking are one-by-one rather than bulk
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports credit limits and one-by-one audits, undermining seamless gap surfacing and generation from one workspace.

exhibits.quote: Nuwtonic turns Google Search Console data, competitor gaps, and AI citation signals into approved fixes your team can ship in minutes.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms it connects to Search Console data to surface gaps and produce fixes.

exhibits.quote: Setup was simple, connecting Google Search Console took a few minutes, and the interface is easy to work with
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Google Search Console connection works quickly and simply.

trials.claim: Scores pages for answer readiness and AI Overview visibility gaps
trials.claimQuote: Score pages for answer readiness, E-E-A-T signals, and AI Overview visibility gaps to know exactly what's keeping you out of AI answers
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm pages are scored for answer readiness, quotability, and citability with specific fix checklists. Reports questioning score accuracy show the scoring feature operates but do not contradict that it is provided.

exhibits.quote: did have some doubts on its accuracy since it was showing that we were popping up for very broad questions that we knew we weren't setup for as well.
exhibits.argument: The buyer doubts visibility scoring accuracy because it showed implausible broad-question coverage.

exhibits.quote: A page audit gave me a 63.3 “Needs Improvement” score even though nearly every technical category was scoring 97–100.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports a contradictory low audit score despite near-perfect subscores, undermining scoring reliability.

exhibits.quote: GEO audit: scores your pages for answer readiness and tells you what to fix first.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms pages are scored for answer readiness with fix guidance.

exhibits.quote: It scores how quotable and citable the page is, and the checklist tells me exactly what to fix.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the GEO audit scores quotability and citability with specific fixes.
